chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 295: The Xiao Family - A Masterclass in Social Tribulation
chapter_meta_description: Han Li intercepts a mysterious old man and his cross-dressing granddaughter after a lavish banquet. No spells fly, but the psychological duel is razor-sharp.
og_description: Han Li doesn’t need to draw a weapon to win this fight. He just stares.
twitter_title: The Art of the Blink: RMJI Ch. 295
twitter_description: Old man grovels, granddaughter bluffs, Han Li just… stares. Psychological warfare at its finest.

lore_anchors.definition: A type of high-stakes conflict in the Mortal Stream where a cultivator must navigate verbal games, social hierarchies, and psychological intimidation with the same cold calculation as a physical battle.
A mental cultivation technique from the Thousand Bamboo School that strengthens a cultivator’s divine sense, allowing them to perceive details and deception that others miss.
The second major cultivation realm; a cultivator who achieves it undergoes a qualitative transformation, gaining far greater mana reserves, lifespan, and divine sense.
The non-physical perception ability of a cultivator, allowing them to detect hidden auras, mana fluctuations, and even subtle facial expressions or deceit a lesser mind would miss.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li just stare instead of saying anything?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He’s using silence as a weapon. By refusing to play along with the old man’s scripted surrender, he forces the duo to run out of prepared responses and reveal their true intentions.

It’s an advanced mental cultivation technique that greatly strengthens a cultivator’s soul and perception, allowing Han Li to see through the young woman’s sly, darting glances that she thinks she’s hiding.
Probably not. Han Li notes that he’s never heard of them, and we readers are left to suspect the old man made up the name to sound specific and therefore credible.
